questions.q: What is this part of the story mostly about?
choices: The monkeys carry Mowgli off, and his friends ask Kaa to help rescue him
Mowgli learns the Master Words and then teaches them to the wolf cubs
Baloo and Bagheera argue so badly that Mowgli runs away to the man village
Kaa the Rock Python hunts the monkeys after they steal his young
questions.evidence: Our man-cub is in the hands of the Bandar-log now

questions.q: What is the answer to the Strangers' Hunting Call?
choices: Hunt then for food, but not for pleasure
We be of one blood, ye and I
Give me leave to hunt here because I am hungry
Good hunting go with you, O brother
questions.evidence: Hunt then for food, but not for pleasure.

questions.q: Why did Baloo say he hit Mowgli, very softly, when the boy forgot his lessons?
choices: He would rather bruise him than see him harmed through not knowing
He was tired of repeating every single lesson a hundred times over
He wanted to show Bagheera which of them was the real teacher
He thought the man-cub was lazy and needed to work harder
questions.evidence: Better he should be bruised from head to foot by me who love him than that he should come to harm through ignorance

questions.q: What are the Master Words for the Hunting People?
choices: We be of one blood, ye and I
Feet that make no noise in the dark
Give me leave to hunt here
Mark my trail and tell my friends
questions.evidence: We be of one blood, ye and I

questions.q: Who helped Mowgli get the Snake Word, because Baloo could not say it?
choices: Hathi the Wild Elephant
Kaa the Rock Python
Rann the Kite
Ikki the Porcupine
questions.evidence: Hathi had taken Mowgli down to a pool to get the Snake Word from a water-snake

questions.q: When Baloo said no one was to be feared, Bagheera whispered, "Except his own tribe." What did he mean?
choices: The wolves of Mowgli's own Pack might one day turn on him
The monkeys were planning to steal Mowgli that very day
Mowgli's human family might one day come to take him back
Baloo himself was the greatest danger to the boy

questions.q: Why did Mowgli first go off with the gray apes?
choices: Baloo had hurt his head and the apes seemed to pity him
He was lost in the trees and they offered to lead him home
Bagheera had told him to go and learn the monkeys' speech
He was hungry, and the apes had promised to show him honey

questions.q: What did the Monkey People promise Mowgli?
choices: That he would be their leader some day
That they would teach him to swing by his tail
That they would protect him from Shere Khan
That they would show him the way to men
questions.evidence: should be their leader some day

questions.q: According to Baloo, what is one big thing wrong with the Bandar-log?
choices: They have no law and no leaders, and they forget everything
They hunt only cattle and bring men with guns into the jungle
They eat young wolf cubs whenever the Pack is out hunting
They speak only the language of men and no jungle tongue
questions.evidence: They have no law. They are outcasts.

questions.q: Baloo calls the monkeys "outcasts." What is an outcast?
choices: Someone shut out and rejected by everyone else
Someone who travels far away from home to hunt
Someone who leads a large and powerful group
Someone who is too young to follow the Law

questions.q: Why did the monkeys want to keep Mowgli in their tribe?
choices: He could weave sticks together, and they hoped he would teach them
They wanted to trade him to Shere Khan for a share of his kills
They hoped Baloo would teach them the Law if they held his pupil
They needed someone tall enough to reach the highest coconuts
questions.evidence: he could weave sticks together for protection from the wind

questions.q: When did the monkeys grab Mowgli?
choices: During the midday nap, as he slept between Baloo and Bagheera
At night, while the wolves were away at the Council Rock
In the morning, as he swam alone in a forest pool
At sunset, while Baloo was teaching him the Wood Laws
questions.evidence: slept between the Panther and the Bear

questions.q: How did Mowgli send a message to his friends while the monkeys carried him off?
choices: He called to Rann the Kite with the Master Words
He dropped broken twigs to mark the trail below
He shouted for Baloo again and again until his voice gave out
He asked a bat to carry word back to the Pack

questions.q: Why could Bagheera not follow the monkeys up into the trees?
choices: The thin branches broke under his weight
Baloo held him back and begged him to wait
The monkeys threw nuts into his eyes
He was afraid of falling so far down
questions.evidence: the thin branches broke beneath his weight

questions.q: Why did Baloo decide they should go to Kaa for help?
choices: Kaa can climb, and the Bandar-log fear him more than anyone
Kaa knows the way to every hidden city in the whole jungle
Kaa is Mowgli's old friend and owes the boy a great favor
Kaa can move faster than any other creature through the grass
questions.evidence: they, the Bandar-log, fear Kaa the Rock Snake

questions.q: What had Kaa been doing for the ten days before Baloo and Bagheera found him?
choices: Changing his skin
Sleeping off a big meal
Hunting the Bandar-log
Hiding from the hunters
questions.evidence: he had been in retirement for the last ten days changing his skin

questions.q: Why did Bagheera tell Kaa the rude names the monkeys had called him?
choices: To make Kaa angry enough to go after the monkeys
To warn Kaa that the monkeys planned to attack him
To show Kaa that the monkeys were cleverer than snakes
To make Kaa laugh before they asked him for a favor

questions.q: According to Rann the Kite, where had the Bandar-log taken Mowgli?
choices: To the monkey city called the Cold Lairs, beyond the river
To the top of the Council Rock where the wolves of the Pack meet
To the man village at the edge of the plowed fields
To Shere Khan's den near the banks of the Waingunga
questions.evidence: to the monkey city--to the Cold Lairs
